Hi Sofia,

Welcome — glad to have EverGreen onboard. We're getting set up to issue PO #67821 for the pilot shipments. To complete vendor setup we need: a completed W-9, bank instructions for ACH + wire (remit format), and the preferred remit-to email for AP notices.

I've attached our vendor onboarding checklist (see Drive link below) — the quickest path is: you upload the W-9 to DocuSign (or paste a PDF), and provide either micro-deposit verification or a bank letter. If you prefer, we can do micro-deposits to verify the account; in that case finance will send small deposits and ask you to confirm amounts.

Two quick clarifications for remittance mapping:
- PO reference required on the remittance: PO67821 (we typically accept either PO or invoice number).
- Preferred remittance file format: CSV with columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, amount, remittance_ref.

Can you send bank details and preferred remittance email by Friday so we can lock in the PO?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

3) We'll send two micro-deposits of random amounts under $1.00 to the ACH account on Wednesday 1/21. Please confirm receipt and the exact amounts in reply.

Document flow:
- EverGreen returns micro-deposit confirmation -> AP validates -> vendor record created -> PO issued -> first invoice scheduled against PO.
